load_data: load parallel, back-parallel, and monolingual datasets for unsupervised neural machine translation
load_binarized: load a binarized torch dataset from disk and return cached or freshly loaded data with vocabulary pruning
check_all_data_params: validate dataset configuration parameters including languages, parallel, monolingual, and back-parallel paths
load_vocab: load vocabulary files per language with minimum count filtering and cross-check against existing dictionaries
set_parameters: define special token indices (EOS, PAD, UNK, blank, BOS) on params from a dictionary and verify consistency
